from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from hashlib import sha256
import json

workspace = Path('/Users/wangye/Desktop/贴纸')
project = workspace / 'outputs/theatre-oops-game'
archive = workspace / 'outputs/简单贴纸-流畅度测试-Cocos工程.zip'
kit = workspace / 'outputs/simple-motion-sticker-kit-v1'
original = workspace / 'outputs/theatre-game/cocos-import/assets'
blocked = {'.git', 'node_modules', 'library', 'temp', 'build', 'builds', 'profiles', '.DS_Store'}
files = sorted(p for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()
               and not any(part in blocked for part in p.relative_to(project).parts))
required = ['README.md', 'UPSTREAM.json', 'assets/main.scene', 'assets/script/Main.ts.meta',
            'assets/script/Main.ts', 'assets/script/MotionPerformanceProbe.ts.meta',
            'assets/theatre/adapters/cocos/PaperMeshSprite.ts',
            'assets/theatre/adapters/cocos/PaperMeshSprite.ts.meta',
            'assets/resources/simple/simple-motion-layout.json',
            'docs/verification/simple-motion-2026-10-03/actual-preview-check.json']
for name in required:
    assert (project / name).is_file(), f'Missing: {name}'
for name in ['assets/main.scene', 'assets/main.scene.meta', 'assets/script/Main.ts.meta']:
    assert (project / name).read_bytes() == (workspace / 'work/github-game-frameworks/oops-framework' / name).read_bytes()
theatre_pngs = sorted((original / 'resources/theatre').rglob('*.png'))
for source in theatre_pngs:
    assert (project / 'assets' / source.relative_to(original)).read_bytes() == source.read_bytes()
simple_pngs = sorted((kit / 'runtime').glob('*.png'))
assert len(simple_pngs) == 7
for source in simple_pngs:
    assert (project / 'assets/resources/simple/assets' / source.name).read_bytes() == source.read_bytes()
with ZipFile(archive, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as z:
    for path in files:
        z.write(path, Path('theatre-oops-game') / path.relative_to(project))
with ZipFile(archive) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    for path in files:
        assert z.read(str(Path('theatre-oops-game') / path.relative_to(project))) == path.read_bytes()
result = {
    'archive': str(archive), 'bytes': archive.stat().st_size,
    'sha256': sha256(archive.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'entries': len(files),
    'crcAndPayloadMatch': True, 'originalSceneAndMainMetaPreserved': True,
    'theatrePngFilesUnchanged': len(theatre_pngs), 'simpleRuntimePngFilesExact': len(simple_pngs),
    'nodeModulesIncluded': False, 'creatorVersion': '3.8.7',
    'actualPreviewEvidence': 'docs/verification/simple-motion-2026-10-03/actual-preview-check.json',
    'wechatDeviceRun': False, 'appBinaryBuilt': False,
    'previousTheatreArchiveReplaced': False,
}
(workspace / 'work/motion-performance-v2/package-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
